title: orni-slab-edu: educational Python for the extended slab near-inertial operator
description: Educational Python implementing the transfer function H (equations 12-16) and Green function G (equations 17-22) of the extended slab mixed-layer operator of Kim (ORNI manuscript), and redrawing manuscript Figures 2 and 3. Controls check G against scipy.linalg.expm and H against the isotropic slab.
